verified: pv magazine reported that the EPA sent termination notices to all 60 Solar for All awardees after the Working Families Tax Cut law rescinded unobligated Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund money, and that on September 18, 2026 a US District Court judge in Rhode Island ruled the termination unlawful — a ruling AP, Utility Dive and Columbia's climate-law blog independently confirm, with the court vacating the EPA's action and ordering the $7 billion program reinstated. The article also cites the National Laboratory of the Rockies' Sharing the Sun dataset putting US community solar at about 11.5 GW across more than 4,280 projects as of January 2026.
unconfirmed: how much of the $7 billion had actually been paid out before termination — CESA's Nate Hausman says only "a fraction," without a figure; whether projects and awardees will resume as planned, since pv magazine says several challenges to the termination were still in court when the issue went to print; and Nexamp's "strong demand" and its secured pipeline of FEOC-compliant equipment, which rest on the company's own account rather than disclosed figures.

verified: 据 pv magazine 报道，Solar for All 是 2022 年《通胀削减法案》设立的 270 亿美元温室气体减排基金（GGRF）中一项 70 亿美元的竞争性拨款计划；联邦政府于 2025 年 3 月终止了 200 亿美元的 GGRF 资金，同年 7 月签署的《Working Families Tax Cut》撤销了未拨付的 GGRF 资金，EPA 据此向全部 60 个受助方发出终止通知。2026 年 9 月 18 日，美国罗德岛联邦地区法院裁定 EPA 终止该项目违法并撤销该决定，哥伦比亚大学法学院气候博客、美联社和 Utility Dive 的报道与这一裁定日期一致。文章援引国家实验室 2026 年 1 月的数据：全美社区太阳能装机约 11.5 GW、逾 4,280 个项目，其中近 4 GW 位于佛罗里达。
unconfirmed: 文章称项目叫停时 70 亿美元中“只有一小部分”已实际拨付，但未给出具体金额，该说法来自受助方聘用人员 Nate Hausman 的个人估计；Nexamp 所称“需求强劲”属公司自述，没有量化数据；在各地多起诉讼仍在审理的情况下，资金是否真正恢复拨付、各州停滞项目何时重启，报道均未给出时间表或确认。

titles.en: US community solar confronts Solar for All funding limbo
